name: fae-v2
description: FAE-v2 monorepo — voice agent with long-term memory

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && uv sync --group dev && cd ../ui && pnpm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,ui,tts -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:tts"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv sync --group dev --quiet && uv run uvicorn fae.api:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:stub: cd backend && uv run python -m fae.tts.stub_server
